topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% antenna efficiency reduces effective gain, weakening signal strength and increasing noise susceptibility. This degrades SNR, beamforming capabilities, and Doppler shift compensation. Mitigations include increasing transmit power, enhancing receiver sensitivity, adaptive coding, and optimizing modulation schemes to maintain reliable transmission.
reference_context: SatCom link budgets consider antenna gains, power constraints, and losses to ensure reliable transmission.
